scope: Three exact-parent UUID 11.1.1 major transitive compatibility overrides; one lock entry

verification.baselineReproduction: Installed uuid 9.0.1 v3/v5 silently partially overwrote bytes 4-7 in an eight-byte Uint8Array initialized to 170; no exception. No v6 baseline claimed.

compatibility.actualConsumerCalls: All three inspected UUID imports call zero-argument v4. Real gax helper and gaxios/teeny multipart paths verified with synthetic transports; sockets forbidden.
compatibility.firebaseSmoke: Unchanged SDK 13.10.0 initializes named synthetic app and rejects malformed token, without obtaining credentials. No valid-token or real provider acceptance.
compatibility.majorChanges: v11 timestamp options/state and types/packaging changes are not assumed universally compatible. Both installed CJS/ESM exports tested. Integer bounds fixtures are not exhaustive arbitrary-input proof.
compatibility.retirement: APP-013 owns exact-parent overrides; re-review any parent/Firebase change or new UUID usage; remove once native patched resolution and bounds/consumer/application/PostgreSQL/browser gates pass.

limits: Zero findings means current npm advisory coverage, not comprehensive security or release acceptance.
No exploitable CallDesk route established for the affected buffer APIs.
Prior Prisma in-place aliasing and future Multer limits/error mappings remain open.
Authorized CREATE orchestration/reader-worker ownership, external-state races, reschedule/cancel and SENDING recovery and acceptance remain open.
